entries.evidence: Block-scoped redeclaration -> TS2451 via tsc --noEmit on "let x = 1; let x = 2;".
Unresolved value reference -> TS2304 via tsc --noEmit on "y = 1;".
Unresolved type reference -> TS2304 via tsc --noEmit on "let x: Foo;" (type positions share TS2304 with value positions).
Initializer not assignable to its annotation -> TS2322 via tsc --noEmit on "const n: number = \"oops\";".
Enum member name that is not an identifier, string literal, or numeric literal -> TS1164 via tsc --noEmit on "const k = \"a\"; enum E { [k] = 1 }".
Enum member without initializer after a non-numeric member -> TS1061 via tsc --noEmit on "enum E { A = \"x\", B }".
Const enum member with a non-constant initializer -> TS2474 via tsc --noEmit on "const enum E { A = f() }"; ambient enum declarations report the same condition as TS1066.
Const enum member initializer evaluating to NaN or Infinity -> TS2477 via tsc --noEmit on "const enum E { A = 1/0 }".
Enum member initializer referencing itself through a later member -> TS2651 via tsc --noEmit on "enum E { A = B, B = A }"; a direct self-reference surfaces as TS2565.
Merged enum declarations disagreeing on constness -> TS2567 via tsc --noEmit on "const enum E { A = 1 } enum E { B = 2 }" (either declaration order).
Two declarations of a merged enum both omitting the first member initializer -> TS2432 via tsc --noEmit on "enum E { A } enum E { B }".
Imported const-enum member that cannot be resolved -> TS2339 via tsc --noEmit on "import { E } from \"./a\"; const x = E.Missing;" with a.ts exporting const enum E.
Qualified type name whose left side is not a namespace -> TS2503 via tsc --noEmit on "let x: A.B;".
Cyclic const-enum re-export chain -> TS2303 via tsc --noEmit on a.ts and b.ts re-exporting E from each other, imported by main.ts.
Imported const-enum member whose initializer is not constant -> TS2474 via tsc --noEmit on "export const enum E { A = f() }" imported from main.ts.
Const-enum export-star lookup with multiple candidates -> TS2308 via tsc --noEmit on "export * from \"./a\"; export * from \"./b\";" where both export E.
Export assignment mixed with other exported elements -> TS2309 via tsc --noEmit --module commonjs on "export = 1; export const x = 2;" (ESM targets additionally report TS1203).
Parameter decorator -> TS1206 via tsc --noEmit on "class A { m(@d x: number) {} }" in the default decorator mode; the legacy --experimentalDecorators mode accepts parameter decorators.
Constructor decorator -> TS1206 via tsc --noEmit on "class A { @d constructor() {} }" in both default and --experimentalDecorators modes.
Intrinsic JSX tag absent from JSX.IntrinsicElements -> TS2339 via tsc --noEmit --jsx preserve on "<bar />" in a .tsx file where IntrinsicElements declares only foo.
JSX element type with neither call nor construct signatures -> TS2604 via tsc --noEmit --jsx preserve on "const X: number = 5; const y = <X />;" in a .tsx file.

JSX attributes not assignable to the element's props type -> TS2322 via tsc --noEmit --jsx preserve on "<foo a=\"s\" />" in a .tsx file with props { a: number } (a missing required prop surfaces as TS2741).
with statement in TypeScript source -> TS1101 via tsc --noEmit on "with ({}) {}"; TypeScript 7.0.2 reports TS1101 in strict, module, and non-strict .ts files alike (and TS2410 in every mode).
Bare super expression not followed by an argument list or member access -> TS1034 via tsc --noEmit on "let x = super;" (also on "super;", "(super)()", and "super`x`").

super call in a class with no base class -> TS2335 via tsc --noEmit on "class A { constructor() { super(); } }" and on base-constructor parameter initializers "class A { constructor(x = super()) {} }".

super call outside a constructor or in a function nested inside one -> TS2337 via tsc --noEmit on "function f() { super(); }", and likewise at top level, in object-literal methods, class methods, field initializers, and static blocks.
super call in derived-constructor parameter initializers -> TS2336 via tsc --noEmit on "class A extends Object { constructor(x = super()) { super(); } }".
Class property with no initializer and no constructor assignment -> TS2564 via tsc --noEmit on "class C { x: number; }".
Assignment to a function identifier -> TS2630 via tsc --noEmit on "function f() {} f = 1;".
Assignment to a namespace identifier -> TS2631 via tsc --noEmit on "namespace N {} N = 1;".
Invalid left-hand side in a for-in statement -> TS2406 via tsc --noEmit on "for (new foo() in b) {}".
'using' declaration as the left-hand side of a 'for...in' statement -> TS1493 via tsc --noEmit on "for (using x in {}) {}".
'await using' declaration as the left-hand side of a 'for...in' statement -> TS1494 via tsc --noEmit on "async function f() { for (await using x in {}) {} }".
`using` or `await using` declaration with a binding pattern -> TS1492 via tsc --noEmit on "for (using {} of []) {}".
`using` or `await using` declaration missing an initializer -> TS1155 via tsc --noEmit on "for (using of;;) break;".
Invalid assignment target -> TS2364 via tsc --noEmit on "new foo() = 1;".
Method, call, or construct signature missing return type -> TS7010 via tsc --noEmit on "interface I { foo(n: string); }".
Variable used before being assigned -> TS2454 via tsc --noEmit on "let x: number; console.log(x);".
Function overload signature missing an immediately following implementation -> TS2391 via tsc --noEmit on "function foo(); 1+1; function foo() {}".
Function declaration inside a block in strict mode when targeting ES5 -> TS1250 via tsc --noEmit on "for(;;) { function f() {} }".
Import declaration conflicts with a local declaration -> TS2440 via tsc --noEmit on "import {f} from "./f1"; function f() {}".

A 'get' accessor cannot have parameters -> TS1054 via tsc --noEmit on "var v = { get foo(v: number) { } };".
A 'get' accessor must return a value -> TS2378 via tsc --noEmit on "var v = { get foo(v: number) { } };".
Function implementation name must match overload signature -> TS2389 via tsc --noEmit on "class C { foo(); bar() {} }".
Type parameters cannot appear on a constructor declaration -> TS1092 via tsc --noEmit on "class C { constructor<T>() { } }".
'export' modifier cannot appear on class elements -> TS1031 via tsc --noEmit on "class C { export get Foo() { } }".
Statements are not allowed in ambient contexts -> TS1036 via tsc --noEmit on a .d.ts file containing 'try { } catch (e) { }'.
Argument type is not assignable to parameter type -> TS2345 via tsc --noEmit on 'function foo(a: string) {}; foo(2);'.
Supplied arguments do not match the expected parameter count -> TS2554 via tsc --noEmit on 'function foo(a: string) {}; foo(); foo("x", "y");'.

Property does not exist on this type -> TS2339 via tsc --noEmit on 'interface I { a: string; } declare var x: I; x.b;'.

Accessor declaring a 'this' parameter -> TS2784 via tsc --noEmit on "var v = { get foo(this: number) { return 1; } };" (upstream message "'get' and 'set' accessors cannot declare 'this' parameters.").
Expression with no construct signatures is constructed -> TS2351 via tsc --noEmit on "const x = 1; new x();" (upstream message "This expression is not constructable.").
